title: profiles.display_names
description: Payload for the profiles.display_names comm Function — the comm form of POST /profiles/api/v1/batch narrowed to the one field a roster needs. Returns {"display_names": {user_id: display_name}} containing ONLY ids that have a non-empty name: missing is not invented, so a caller can tell "no name here" from "a name that is empty" and fall back to whatever it holds locally.
